event_text: Downdetector says user reports of Bitbucket problems begin, per an Australian outlet
notes: Second-hand; we have not seen the tracker data.

event_text: Atlassian opens a Bitbucket status incident: OAuth token requests may fail or time out
Atlassian says it has identified the cause and teams are working on a mitigation; it does not say what the cause is
Atlassian posts the same incident on its Jira Service Management, Trello and Developer status pages
notes: 16:08 UTC. The Jira status page carried it from 10:19 AM.

event_text: Atlassian says it has applied a mitigation and sees signs of recovery; the incident moves to monitoring
notes: 16:33 UTC. Repeated at 11:57 AM ET (Bitbucket) and 12:26 PM ET (Jira); not resolved at 1:35 PM ET.

event_text: Atlassian adds the same incident to its Confluence status page, dated from 10:19 AM, and moves it to monitoring at 1:10 PM
